title.zh: 第 26 关组装问题修复

summary.en: Level 26 now opens the Newtonian assembly bench and keeps the starter refractor tube out of the active loadout. Existing saves are repaired when loaded.
summary.zh: 第 26 关现在会打开牛顿镜组装台，入门折射镜筒不会再占用当前装备；已有存档加载时会自动修正。

items.en: After Level 25, the assembly table automatically selects the Newtonian bench required by Level 26. A save that still remembers the refractor bench is corrected on load.
items.zh: 完成第 25 关后，组装台会自动切换到第 26 关需要的牛顿镜；仍记着折射镜组装台的旧存档也会在加载时修正。

items.en: The starter tube and other refractor-only parts are no longer shown as equipped or offered for the Newtonian bench. Switching telescope types clears incompatible selections.
items.zh: 入门镜筒等折射镜专用零件不再显示为牛顿镜已装备零件；切换镜型时会清理不兼容的装备状态。

footer.en: Your existing save can continue. Thank you for reporting the assembly problem.
footer.zh: 现有存档可以继续使用。感谢大家反馈组装问题。
